title: Tasks
summary: Tasks for you and your teams: the list and the board, finishing a task, can't do, recurring tasks and stats.

blocks.text: Team › Tasks lists the tasks for you and your teams. The number on the Team tab is how many of yours are due today or overdue.

items: **List** groups open tasks into Overdue, Today and Upcoming.
**Board** shows them as cards in To do, In progress and Done. Drag a card, or use its buttons.
**In progress** tells everyone someone has started. The task is still open.
**Overdue only** shows open tasks past their due time.
Tap the circle (or swipe right in the app) to finish it. If it needs a photo or a note, you're asked first.
Tap a task for its steps, comments and history, or to say you **can't do it**, with a reason. Whoever asked is told.
A task for a team is one task: whoever on the team does it first closes it for everyone.
A task sent to several people gives each their own copy; the sender sees "2 of 3 done".

blocks.text: Admins set up reusable tasks with optional **steps** (one per line) under Setup › [Recurring tasks](page:team_templates):

items: **On a schedule**: created by itself daily, on weekdays, weekly or monthly. **Someone else on some days?** gives chosen weekdays to another person or team.
**Only when I create it**: saved without a schedule. **Create task now** makes one at once.
Repeating tasks show up 7 hours before they are due.

blocks.text: For tasks created in the last 7, 14, 30 or 90 days: per person, assigned and done, on time or late, overdue now, can't do, and the usual time from created to done. Teams get their own rows.
